question: how healthy is this company?

profitability.reading: Trailing-four-quarter margins are high and mostly improved against the company's own recent past: gross margin {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct}, operating margin {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} and net margin {ratios.profitability.net_margin|pct}. Operating margin sits above fiscal 2025's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct} and about level with the three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}, but still below the fiscal 2020 to fiscal 2023 range, for example {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin|pct} in fiscal 2023. Return on assets is {ratios.profitability.return_on_assets|pct}, return on equity {ratios.profitability.return_on_equity|pct} and return on invested capital {ratios.profitability.return_on_invested_capital|pct}. Two pressures sit under the headline. First, the latest quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} is the lowest of the six filled quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} a year earlier; the MD&A names product mix toward Networking and higher memory costs. Second, part of the nine-month operating margin gain came from lower restructuring and amortization charges, and the MD&A now expects a new restructuring charge in the fourth quarter under a plan of up to one billion dollars, with the savings to be reinvested rather than kept. Net income also grew faster than operating income, {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} against {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year, helped by gains on equity securities in other income, while the trailing effective tax rate rose to {tax_rate.value|pct} as the foreign-derived intangible income deduction shrank.

efficiency.reading: On the trailing basis days sales outstanding is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding} days, days sales of inventory {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory} days and days payables outstanding {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding} days, giving a cash conversion cycle of {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle} days; asset turnover is {ratios.efficiency.asset_turnover}. Against the company's own quarterly history both working-capital measures have moved the wrong way. The quarter's days sales of inventory, {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}, is the highest of the six filled quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} a year earlier, and the quarter's days sales outstanding, {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}, is the second highest, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}. Inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} year over year, equal to {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income.value|pct} of trailing net income, and receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change.value}; trade working capital moved from {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.a_year_earlier.value} to {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now.value}. The MD&A explains the inventory build as commitments for Silicon One and memory components to serve hyperscaler demand and says balances may rise further. Channel partner financing volume also grew, which the notes say can move receivables off the balance sheet, so the reported receivables rise may understate the credit the company is extending. Against the annual history, fiscal 2025 days sales of inventory was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} and days sales outstanding {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}.

liquidity.reading: The current ratio is {ratios.liquidity.current_ratio} and the quick ratio {ratios.liquidity.quick_ratio}: current assets of {terms.balances_now.current_assets.value} sit below current liabilities of {terms.balances_now.current_liabilities.value}. Two things soften that. Current liabilities carry deferred revenue of {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value}, which is settled by delivering service rather than paying cash, and cash plus short-term investments are {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now.value}. What hardens it is the current debt: {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.value} now against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.parts.debt_current.value} a year earlier, mostly commercial paper that the MD&A says funded part of the year's cash build alongside the release of escrowed restricted cash. No cash runway is computed: the calculator states that trailing free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} is not negative, so there is no burn to divide by. Operating cash flow is the softer point. The nine-month figure fell against the prior year, the trailing four quarters are down {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, and operating cash flow over net income at {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} is well below fiscal 2025's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, with the inventory build and larger income tax payments visible in the filing. Dividends of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid.value} and repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases.value} were paid over the same four quarters while net borrowing of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity.net_borrowing} was an inflow, so shareholder returns were funded in part by new debt. Unrecorded inventory purchase commitments roughly doubled from fiscal year-end according to the numbers report; that figure is not in the calculator, which reports the purchase-obligation row as missing for this period.

solvency.reading: Total debt is {ratios.solvency.total_debt}, against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.value} a year earlier, and net debt after cash and short-term investments is {ratios.solvency.net_debt}. Interest coverage on operating income is {ratios.solvency.interest_coverage} times, which is comfortable; trailing interest expense was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.value}, and the MD&A attributes the decline to a lower average debt balance and a cheaper commercial paper rate. Liabilities over assets are {ratios.solvency.liabilities_over_assets} and operating lease liabilities {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}. Debt over EBITDA is not computed: the calculator has no depreciation and amortization row for the current year-to-date period, so EBITDA and that ratio are both missing. The pressure point is the shape of the debt rather than its size — the current portion of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.value} rose sharply while noncurrent debt fell, so more of the stack must be refinanced within a year. Outside the calculator, the notes carry unaccrued Brazilian tax claims for tax, interest and penalties, restated at the period-end exchange rate, and an unrecognized tax benefit balance; neither is measured as a liability in the filed statements.

growth.reading: Revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year in the quarter, {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} against the prior quarter and {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} on the trailing four quarters, well above the company's three-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} and a reversal of fiscal 2024's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.revenue_growth|pct}. Operating income grew faster than revenue, {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year and {ratios.growth.operating_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct} trailing, and net income grew {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year and {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct} trailing, the latter helped by non-operating investment gains. Operating cash flow is the exception: {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} year over year for the quarter and {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct} trailing; the quarter-over-quarter figure of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} looks large only because the prior quarter was weak. The MD&A shows the growth is narrow in source — Americas product revenue led by AI infrastructure sold to service providers and cloud customers — while subscription revenue, services revenue, the Collaboration category and services remaining performance obligations all declined, and total remaining performance obligations were flat against fiscal year-end.

free_cash_flow.reading: Simple free cash flow over the trailing four quarters is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, from operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.value} less capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value}; it is below fiscal 2025's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.free_cash_flow_simple} because operating cash flow fell and capital expenditure rose from {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure.value} a year earlier. Free cash flow to equity is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity}, higher than the simple figure because net borrowing of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity.net_borrowing} was an inflow. Quality-adjusted free cash flow is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}, after deducting share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} and acquisition spend of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value}; share-based compensation is a large and growing claim on the cash the business generates. Free cash flow to the firm is missing: the calculator states that depreciation and amortization has no row for the current year-to-date period, so the formula cannot be completed. Earnings and cash still agree in direction — operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and accruals over average assets {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets} — but the margin of cash over earnings has narrowed from the company's own past, when the annual ratio ran well above one.

dupont.reading: Return on equity of {ratios.profitability.return_on_equity|pct} is net margin {ratios.profitability.dupont.net_margin|pct} times asset turnover {ratios.profitability.dupont.asset_turnover} times an equity multiplier of {ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier}; Python's product is {ratios.profitability.dupont.product|pct}. The equity multiplier carries the most weight: liabilities are {ratios.solvency.liabilities_over_assets|pct} of assets, so a modest return on assets is levered into a much higher return on equity. Turnover is the drag, at {ratios.efficiency.asset_turnover}, because the balance sheet is dominated by goodwill, intangibles and investments — the soft-asset share of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value|pct} is the highest of the six filled quarters. Net margin is the component that has moved: operating margin recovered from fiscal 2025's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}, and it is this recovery, not turnover or leverage, that lifts return on equity. The calculator carries no prior-year DuPont decomposition, so the movement in the other two factors is read from the balances: assets and equity both rose modestly year over year, so the multiplier is broadly unchanged, and turnover improved slightly with revenue.

anomalies.name: Quarterly gross margin at the lowest of six filled quarters
anomalies.name_ko: 분기 매출총이익률이 여섯 개 분기 중 최저

The MD&A attributes the product margin decline to mix toward Networking, higher memory costs and, to a lesser extent, pricing; the overview and the detailed section list the drivers differently.

anomalies.name: New restructuring plan reverses part of the margin help
anomalies.name_ko: 신규 구조조정 계획으로 마진 개선 일부가 되돌려질 전망
anomalies.what: The nine-month operating margin gain was helped by lower restructuring and amortization charges. A new plan announced after quarter end carries up to one billion dollars of pre-tax charges, with a large part expected in the fourth quarter, and the MD&A says the savings will be reinvested so overall cost savings are not expected to be material. Trailing operating margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} therefore carries a charge-light base that will not persist into the next quarter.

anomalies.name: Net income growth outruns operating income on investment gains
anomalies.name_ko: 투자 평가이익으로 순이익 증가율이 영업이익 증가율을 앞섬

Other non-operating income turned from a loss to a gain, nine-month investment gains swung positive, and the MD&A attributes the change primarily to gains on marketable and non-marketable equity securities, the latter valuation-driven under the measurement alternative and a new restricted-securities category with a management-applied marketability discount.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate stepping up
anomalies.name_ko: 유효세율 상승
anomalies.what: The trailing effective tax rate used by the calculator is {tax_rate.value|pct}, and the filing shows the nine-month rate far above the prior-year nine months, which carried a one-time benefit. The MD&A attributes the quarter's increase to a smaller foreign-derived intangible income deduction, partly offset by research credits. A higher rate compresses net margin even when pre-tax income grows.

anomalies.name: Memory costs, mix and pricing pressing on product margin

The prose ties this to the same AI-infrastructure demand that drives growth, so the margin pressure is structural to the current growth mix rather than incidental; the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} is the visible result.

anomalies.name: Cash flow growth negative against strong earnings growth
anomalies.name_ko: 이익 고성장에도 영업현금흐름 성장률은 마이너스

The quarter-over-quarter figure of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} reflects a weak prior quarter rather than a recovery, since the year-over-year quarter figure is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}. anomalies.name: Management's own forward statements: more inventory, a restructuring charge
anomalies.name_ko: 경영진의 전망: 재고 추가 증가와 사분기 구조조정 비용
anomalies.what: No external expectation baseline is in the input, so results cannot be compared with consensus. Management's own forward statements are the only benchmark: inventory balances, already at {terms.balances_now.inventory.value} with days sales of inventory at {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory}, may increase further, and a pre-tax restructuring charge is expected in the fourth quarter under a plan of up to one billion dollars. Both point to the next quarter's operating margin and working capital being worse than this quarter's before any change in demand.

path_to_distress.reading: On its filed numbers this company is not near distress: interest coverage is {ratios.solvency.interest_coverage} times, trailing free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} is positive so no cash runway is computed, and cash plus short-term investments of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now.value} are larger than current debt of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.value}. For the pressure now visible to become distress, several things would have to happen together. The commercial paper that makes up most of the current debt would have to become hard to roll while the current ratio of {ratios.liquidity.current_ratio} stays below one and the quick ratio at {ratios.liquidity.quick_ratio}. The inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory.value} and the purchase commitments behind it, including variable-priced memory from a concentrated supplier, would have to meet a demand shortfall from the hyperscaler customers now driving growth, forcing write-downs that push the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} down further from its six-quarter low. Operating cash flow, already moving {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct} on the trailing basis, would have to keep falling while dividends of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid.value} and repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases.value} are maintained with borrowing. And operating income would have to fall far enough that coverage of interest expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.value} became thin, which at the current margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} would take a very large revenue decline. None of these is present in the filed numbers; what is present is a working-capital and short-term-funding stretch on top of a profitable, growing business with a softening recurring base.

summary_ko.profitability: 최근 네 분기 기준 매출총이익률 {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct}, 영업이익률 {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct}, 순이익률 {ratios.profitability.net_margin|pct}로 수익성은 높고, 자기자본이익률은 {ratios.profitability.return_on_equity|pct}입니다. 다만 이번 분기 매출총이익률 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct}는 여섯 개 분기 중 최저이며, 다음 분기에는 최대 십억 달러 규모 구조조정 비용이 예정되어 있습니다.
